newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock futures end shortened session higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock futures end shortened session higher.

text.p: Nov 29 - U.S. stock index futures ended mostly higher in an abbreviated session Friday, helped by strong bond prices. After an early surge, Dec S&P 500 futures range traded and were unable to hold above resistance at 760.50, traders said. Sentiment seen firm next week into the November U.S. jobs report, due December 6.--Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/Email:derivatives@reuters.com
